items.text: Avoid foul language, toxicity, and bringing controversies or external news to the server.
Dramas and public fights = penalty. Problems are resolved by ticket.
Content 18+, NSFW, or sexual = immediate expulsion. Includes buildings, messages, skins, and profile pictures.
Any sexual advances towards minors (grooming) = expulsion and report to the appropriate authorities.
Do not share or ask for personal information from minors (real age, location, private networks).
Protection is based on age, not perceived maturity. A mature minor gains trust and responsibilities, never exemption from protection.
Prohibited: political flags, ideologies, controversial symbols (swastikas, hate symbols), gore, violent and offensive content.
Permitted historical buildings: Castles, Taj Mahal, monuments, provided they do not include offensive symbols.
This applies equally to Minecraft (buildings, skins, capes, signs) and to Discord (photo, banner, name, bio).
If the staff asks you to change a symbol, skin, or profile, you change it. It's not censorship: it's about community.
Threatening to leave to avoid a rule doesn't excuse you from following it. The door is wide open, but the rules apply while you're inside.
The rules also apply to private messages. Insults via DM are still punishable.
Do not spam links to third-party servers or flood (send repetitive messages).
Do not overuse capital letters or repeatedly mention the Staff without a real emergency.
Participating in raids against the community = permanent expulsion and IP ban.
Read the name and description of each channel before writing. Do not enter voice or chat channels to disrupt others.
Discord's Terms and Conditions apply to the entire community.
When a new version of Minecraft is released, we wait 1-2 weeks to verify mod/datapack compatibility.
Mods or datapacks with no real utility may be removed without prior notice.
Suggest mods/datapacks with real utility per ticket. We evaluate whether to add them.
The updated official list is on the wiki.
If you're unsure whether something is allowed, ask before doing it.
The staff has the final say in situations not covered by these rules.
Events are announced on Discord. Participation is voluntary.
Respect the event rules. Breaking them will result in disqualification and possible sanctions.
After 60 days of inactivity, your area may be released for new players.
If you're going to be inactive, let the staff know to keep your whitelist.
The server remains active 24/7 on a dedicated host. We no longer depend on home electricity or internet.
Daily Restart: Once a day, the device automatically restarts to clear RAM. A few minutes of inactivity is normal.
The staff may take the server offline for scheduled maintenance. We will announce this on Discord when possible.
Report lag by ticket with coordinates. This helps us identify problem areas.
Avoid accumulating entities without a purpose (hundreds of animals, infinite villagers).
Do not leave permanently active redstone that you are not using.
Premium (Mojang): You enter via an approved whitelist on Discord.
Non-Premium: You must use an Ely.by account with a compatible launcher (ElyPrism or XMCL).
Improper skins or skins that violate rules = sanction, whether Mojang or Ely.by.
If a friend, family member, or stranger logs in with your account and breaks the rules, the penalty will be applied to your account.
Keep your password secure. Staff will not waive penalties for security lapses.
Impersonating a staff member will result in immediate expulsion. No one on the team will ask for your password.
Attempting to evade a temporary ban with multiple accounts = permanent Discord ban and IP ban from the server.
Alternative accounts are only allowed after explicit authorization from the Staff (e.g., lost password).
Anyone who has been banned can submit an appeal via ticket. The final decision rests with the staff.
Destroying or altering other people's constructions without permission = review of events and possible expulsion.
Taking items from other people's chests (even if they are unprotected) is a serious breach of honesty.
If it was you: cooperate in the reconstruction. Refusal will increase the penalty.
Your gate obstructs another base and doesn't have a sign with your name = the owner can remove it.
Recommended: sign with coordinates or owner's name on each doorway.
Accidental portal synchronization (by nearby chunks) is analyzed on a case-by-case basis.
If you're going to be inactive for a long time, please notify the staff. Your whitelist status will remain.
After prolonged abandonment without notice, the Staff may release the area (with prior notice if possible).
Abandoned shops in commercial areas can be removed after 21 days of inactivity.
X-Ray = permanent ban. Includes mods, resource packs, lava transparency, or using the seed to find minerals.
Any mod that gives an unfair advantage (fly, reach, killaura, ESP, tracers) is prohibited.
Using the seed to find structures (including copper/iron veins) is also considered X-Ray.
Prohibited: autoclickers, auto-mining, auto-attack, auto-eating, auto-replanting, macros.
Authorized fake players (`/player`) are the only controlled exception.
Exploiting vanilla bugs or plugins for an unfair advantage will result in penalties. Report bugs, don't exploit them.
PvP is only allowed if both players consent. Return the items to the player who died.
Don't spam kills against the same player. Give them time to disable PvP.
Do not attack staff while they are performing their duties.
Machines based on chance (roulette, slots, betting) are prohibited.
Skill-based machines are allowed (target shooting, racing).
No limits on farms, but limits animals and unnecessary redstone.
Chunk loaders only when absolutely necessary. Not for keeping farms running 24/7.
Contraptions TNT "lazy chunk" (like some mining machines) are not allowed.
Full list of allowed and prohibited mods on the wiki.
If you're unsure about a mod, ask for a ticket before using it.
Only with trusted friends. If you don't know how they'll react, don't do it.
Obligated to restore the damage if the affected party requests it.
The use of fire, TNT, lava, or high-value objects in pranks is prohibited.
Maximum 2 suggestive works per player.
Only in private areas (basements, bedrooms). Displaying them in public will result in a fine.
If someone sees your content because you didn't protect it, the responsibility is yours.
The staff has the final say on what is art and what is prohibited. No arguments will be accepted.
Do not create offensive symbols or disturbing messages.
Inappropriate content publicly visible = mandatory removal and penalty.
Free exchange of items between players within the server.
Shops with clearly marked signs are welcome.
**Selling items, accounts, or services for real money (PayPal, crypto, etc.) is prohibited. This will result in immediate expulsion.
Defrauding other players (promising something and not delivering) = penalty according to severity.
Do not use the server to promote external sales or personal business.
Do not copy designs from other stores to deliberately undercut prices.
Respect the server's economy: do not artificially inflate prices.
Please be patient with responses. We don't demand immediate attention: we work, study, and rest.
Repeated mentions of Staff without a real emergency = temporary mute.
Insulting or belittling a team member = withdrawal of access.
If an admin makes a mistake, please report it calmly and respectfully via ticket. It will be investigated.
Anyone who has been banned can appeal by submitting a ticket. The final decision rests with the staff.
Minor: Warning or temporary mute. Minor offenses or first offenses.
Serious: Temporary ban. Recurring or medium-impact offenses.
Expulsion: Permanent ban. Serious offenses (X-Ray, fraud, evasion, impersonation).
The staff evaluates context, intent, harm, and recidivism to make a decision.
Don't ask for roles. They are only given when the staff needs a new member.
The staff applies the rules equally to everyone. If they decide that something should no longer be the rule, they first change the rule and then apply it.
Turning a blind eye is also a choice: the staff is responsible for what they tolerate in spaces where there are minors.
